Table

datatable(plate.merge)

Visulization

All data points

# boxplot, all data points
ggplot(plate.merge, aes(timepoint, norm.LCAT.ratio))+
    geom_boxplot()+
    geom_point(aes(color = subject), position = position_jitter())+
    # geom_line(aes(color = subject, group = subject)) +
    facet_grid(~treatment) +
    theme_bw() +
        labs(y = "Normalized \n LCAT Activity", x = "Time Point")

Boxplot + lineplot

# boxplot, mean for each subject
plate.merge %>%
    ggplot(aes(timepoint, norm.LCAT.ratio))+
    geom_boxplot()+
    geom_point(aes(color = subject))+
    geom_line(aes(color = subject, group = subject)) +
    facet_grid(~treatment) +
    theme_bw() +
        labs(y = "Normalized \n LCAT Activity", x = "Time Point")

Mean for each subject + batch 1&2

# boxplot, show batch 1&2
plate.merge %>%
    group_by(subject, timepoint, treatment, Batch) %>%
    ggplot(aes(timepoint, norm.LCAT.ratio))+
    geom_boxplot()+
    geom_point(aes(color = subject))+
    geom_line(aes(color = subject, group = subject)) +
    facet_grid(Batch~treatment) +
    theme_bw() +
        labs(y = "Normalized \n LCAT Activity", x = "Time Point")

HDL-C correlation with LCAT (Pearson Correlation)

# CHeck normality
shapiro.test(plate.merge$norm.LCAT.ratio)
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  plate.merge$norm.LCAT.ratio
## W = 0.99335, p-value = 0.9589
shapiro.test(plate.merge$HDL)
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  plate.merge$HDL
## W = 0.94722, p-value = 0.002588
## Log transform HDL

plate.merge <- plate.merge %>%
        mutate(log_HDL = log(HDL))

shapiro.test(plate.merge$log_HDL)
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  plate.merge$log_HDL
## W = 0.98486, p-value = 0.4754
cor.test(plate.merge$norm.LCAT.ratio, plate.merge$log_HDL, method = "pearson")
## 
##  Pearson's product-moment correlation
## 
## data:  plate.merge$norm.LCAT.ratio and plate.merge$log_HDL
## t = 2.1327, df = 77, p-value = 0.03614
## alternative hypothesis: true correlation is not equal to 0
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  0.01588609 0.43458382
## sample estimates:
##       cor 
## 0.2361669
ggscatter(plate.merge, x = "norm.LCAT.ratio", y = "log_HDL", color = "timepoint coded",
   add = "reg.line",  # Add regressin line
   add.params = list(color = "blue", fill = "lightgray"), # Customize reg. line
   conf.int = TRUE # Add confidence interval
   ) + stat_cor(method = "pearson", label.x = 1.05, label.y = 5) +
        labs(y = "log(HDL)", x = "Normalized LCAT Activity")
## `geom_smooth()` using formula 'y ~ x'
